name: DHL Supply Chain - Union City DC (Derrick Industrial) - Union City GA

fieldNotes.operatingStatus: This is the DHL Supply Chain ASOS fulfillment center on Derrick Industrial Parkway. DHL filed a WARN/state layoff notice in Feb 2025 to CLOSE this facility (600+ employees), with layoffs effective ~April 6, 2025 (AJC, Newnan CEO). The building is physically intact in current (2026) imagery, but operational status as an active DHL site is uncertain/likely wound down. Audited as the physical facility.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard-booth checkpoint identified in satellite or Street View. The site is accessed by a single SW entry road off Derrick Industrial Parkway leading to the dock yard and employee parking. A perimeter access road with painted lane chevrons rings the building but shows no controlled pinch-point. Flagged uncertain - imagery resolution and tree cover limit confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure visible at the entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large E-commerce fulfillment center; continuous dock-door bank along the NW face with dock numbers visible to 389+ in Street View. Estimated ~90 doors, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only ~6-8 trailers seen in a small drop area at the W end; 0-10 band for trailers parked without tractors in marked stalls.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Small dedicated trailer-storage cluster (red/orange/white trailers) at the W edge of the parking/yard area.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entry road and large open paved yard give ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long SW entry road and perimeter drive provide deep queuing space (3+ trucks).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Union City / South Fulton, within the Atlanta metro, west of Hartsfield-Jackson airport. Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box includes the cleared developed footprint; the parcel also has substantial wooded buffer. ~64 acres for the cleared area is an estimate.

citations.claim: DHL Supply Chain filed a Georgia WARN notice to close its Derrick Industrial Parkway, Union City facility; 600+ employees; cuts begin April 6 2025, phased shutdown through August 2025.

verification.rationale: This exact Derrick Industrial Parkway building is being phased closed under a Feb 2025 Georgia WARN notice (600+ jobs, shutdown through Aug 2025).
